storage: Airtight jar, cool dark cupboard, away from damp, for up to about a year.
looksLike: Small, hard, angular seeds, mustard-yellow to amber, about 3 mm; bitter when raw.
howToPick: Hard, evenly golden-yellow seeds with a strong, slightly bitter smell; avoid dusty, dark, shrivelled or musty seeds and any with insect holes.
shelfLife: About 1 year or more if kept dry (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Leave it out of dosa batter

usedIn.raw: 1 g per serving (a pinch, about ⅕ tsp, soaked with the urad dal)

mergeNotes: Range 90.0–281.1 was wider than 30% of avg 201.1; narrowed to ±15%.
